title: Made a Netflix style browser for all the AI games I'm making.
author: PulIthEld

comments.author: PulIthEld
comments.body:
I dont know why.  I dont know what I'm doing anymore honestly.  I'm making all these things that I think are fun but doubt anyone would play.

I think we've reached the point where you just make shit for yourself unless its really got a large enough following where multiplayer is worth it.  What do you think?

I'd post the link but you'd just crash the server.  I guess this is what Itch.IO and steam are for?

I'm honestly kinda depressed.  I spent my whole life building skills to be a game developer and now its just a worthless skill anyone can just pump games out.   Even web development is a worthless skill, who needs help building anything software related anymore.

replies.body:
I guess if you’re making fast food games you do it at home now. 

I’ve found that it’s is still a lot of work to make something deeper.

replies.author: PulIthEld

>I’ve found that it’s is still a lot of work to make something deeper.

Theres multitudes less chance a game with a lot of hard work will get noticed in the age of AI.  Theres just so many games now.  How do you stand out?

The risk is so much higher now to put all that work in to a single title.

replies.author: Aineisa
replies.body:
Disagree. 

Ebbtide, Defilade, There Is Eternal War…. All games that use AI tools and have built followings. There was even a game about playing as a raincloud watering gardens that got tons of attention. 

You need a good premise, quality control, not one-shots.

replies.author: PulIthEld
replies.body:
The game list above:

Descent - 1st person/3rd person Diablo 2 in a post bronze age collapse setting with original quests and enemies, but Diablo 2 itemization and 1:1 abilities for now (planning on making them different).  I wanted to make a world with lore set in real history.

Dead Mile - Roguelike progression racing game.

Path of Defiance - Idle ARPG similar to path of exile in some ways.

Sir this is A Wandas - Job Sim fast food game

Age of Defiance - Single player Hero game where you play inside of an RTS game essentially.  So all your actions and timings matter, and you try to eliminate the other factions.

Kingdom of Defiance - Skyrim clone

World of Defiance - WoW clone

Hero Arena - Mechabellum style autobattler but with fantasy setting.

A few more not pictured of various genres.

replies.author: PulIthEld
replies.body:
I feel like I'm learning this way trying different games and testing the limits of AI.  

The more times I make a game the easier it gets, the better each one gets.  

I learn why some games take longer and what effort pays off the most.

I can spend weeks on a game and then realize a single prompt game can be more engaging, then think about why that is and what the other game may be missing or doing wrong.

Lastly I just get the itch to make a lot of games so I can play them and feel what they're like.

comments.author: Appropriate_Air7307
comments.body:
This is an interesting conversation. I don’t like to throw the term slop around cause I don’t know how much has gone into your endeavor. I can say this, I’m making a first person horror game right now. No weapons and a stalker monster in a psych ward. I could have said “hey make outlast” but I didn’t even reference it. It’s taking weeks so far. I think you can use your inspiration as references without ripping off the whole idea. You still have to test and balance and make the features work with one another. 

My monster KEEPS getting stuck. So I keep going in and have Chat diagnose the why and then test. AI game dev doesn’t have to be clones and slop

replies.author: ffktiv
replies.body:
Physics around jumps can be wonky.

By movement I meant that it follows the car properly, based on what you're doing. Check out some of the newer NFS games and see that the camera goes far when you're in a long jump and when you're back at ground it goes very close to you until it backs away again to normal.

Graphics are far from what I imagine it to be.

Power ups/weapons attached to vehicles is what I had in mind. Several slots activated with 1234.

Open world set in a desert is also what I had in mind but I don't think you can do that in the browser.

It's an okay game to kill time but far from my vision.
